lines.zh: 我在魔界的红雾里漂移。
lines.en: I drift through the demon realm's red mist.

lines.zh: 这里的天空是暗紫色的。
lines.en: The sky here is dark violet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过魔界的山脊。
lines.en: I shift over the ridges of the demon realm.
My shadow falls on the jagged stones.
The mist travels with me.

lines.zh: 我穿过一道窄缝，很勉强。
lines.en: I squeeze through a narrow gap.
My scales reflect a red glow.

lines.zh: 我不用翅膀，也一样能飘。
lines.en: I need no wings to float.

lines.zh: 地下的岩层被我压得低响。
lines.en: The rock below groans under my weight.

lines.zh: 我绕着魔界的塔转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the demon realm's tower once.
As I move, the mist parts.
I rise slowly to the height.
I hang in the middle of the red mist.
The demon realm's three wishes remain.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛照着这片石林。
lines.en: My eyes light this stone forest.

lines.zh: 我在等一个召唤的声音。
lines.en: I wait for a summoning voice.
The demon realm's wind tastes of rust.
I coil my tail around the tower.
I let out a slow breath.

lines.zh: 魔界的时间流过得很慢。
lines.en: Time passes slowly in the demon realm.

lines.zh: 我的头顶压着低低的云。
lines.en: Low clouds press on my head.
I don't blink; I only watch.

lines.zh: 石头在我脚下裂开了一点。
lines.en: Stone cracks a little beneath me.
I have been here a long while.
Red mist curls around my claws.
I count the fires of the demon realm.

lines.zh: 你是从上面的世界来的。
lines.en: You come from the world above.
State your wish. Don't circle it.
You stand on demon-realm stone.
Three wishes. Very precious.
I can tell you're afraid.
Have you thought it through?
I know the demon realm's summoning.
Your scent is unfamiliar.
You hold the balls up for me.
When you speak, the red mist clears.
I lower my head, and you step back.
I grant, and I don't judge.
This pain doesn't concern me.
One more mark on my scales.
My enormous head lists to one side.

lines.zh: 你的力气不小，可惜不够。
lines.en: Good strength, but not enough.
I breathe out and the mist thickens.
My vast body rocks.
I tighten my claws a little.
I'll remember this one too.
No more; it means nothing.
I lift my head and the sky darkens further.
Food? I have no need.

lines.zh: 那点光芒，让我想起召唤。
lines.en: That gleam reminds me of summoning.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我看见了。
lines.en: You raise it high; I see it.

lines.zh: 声音比食物更能引来我。
lines.en: A voice draws me better than food.
I come closer, and the mist thickens.
Say one sentence and I'll listen.
I stretch my head near, and the air presses down.
Do you want me to stay?
My claw stops in midair.
It's quiet here; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的鳞，冷得像石。
lines.en: You touch my scales, cold as stone.

lines.zh: 我让开一点，石头滚下去。
lines.en: I shift aside and stones tumble down.
My tail brushes the tower.
Air pressure shoves you back.
I pull in my claws so as not to hurt you.
That touch I didn't feel.

lines.zh: 你站在我爪间，像颗石子。
lines.en: You stand between my claws like a pebble.
I lower my head and give you room.

lines.zh: 魔界的石头被我们挤碎了。
lines.en: Demon-realm stone crumbles between us.
You hit me and bounce off.
Another dragon of the demon realm arrives.

lines.zh: 我们在红雾里并排悬着。
lines.en: We hang side by side in the red mist.
Its horns curve more than mine.
Our breathing pushes the mist aside.
We coil around this tower together.
Its scales are cracked and old.

lines.zh: 谁也没说话，雾替我们说。
lines.en: Neither speaks; the mist speaks for us.
The demon realm's night is long.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一处召唤台。
lines.en: We guard the same summoning dais.
At the demon realm's edge, only we remain.

lines.zh: 我夹起一颗滚落的珠子。
lines.en: I pinch up a fallen ball.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我看得清。
lines.en: So small, and I see it clearly.
I set it on the tower top.
This isn't mine; I give it back.
It glimmers in my palm.
One touch and it crumbles.
I take the ball into the mist.
These must be gathered together.
I pick it up and weigh it.
I know a demon-realm summons when I see one.
You'd strike in the demon realm?
I don't fight, but I watch.
Your hand has come up.

lines.zh: 这一下，记在你的愿望里。
lines.en: I will count this against your wish.
My eyes turn onto you.
You have one chance left.
The red mist begins pressing toward you.
I rise, and the tower groans.
Are you certain about this?
The wish is not yet spoken.
I lower my head and watch your hand.
Don't make me change my mind.
The demon realm doesn't permit this.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我已经看着你了。
lines.en: You look up; I'm already watching.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的头转到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my head follows.

lines.zh: 红雾把我们的影子连起来。
lines.en: The red mist joins our shadows.
I don't chase; you can't leave.
There is only one road in this realm.

lines.zh: 我的头一点一点压下来。
lines.en: My head sinks a little at a time.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在雾里很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is clear in the mist.
I have counted your steps to seven.
The dais is where I stand.

lines.zh: 我占着天上，你占着地上。
lines.en: I hold the sky; you hold the ground.

lines.zh: 我不着急，时间在我这边。
lines.en: I'm not hurried; time favors me.
One step nearer and I lower my head.
Three wishes, then I leave.
The mist thickens.
I'm counting the breaths you take.
I have always been here.
I don't attack; I only set my claw down.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴挪了一下，石碎了。
lines.en: My tail shifts once and stone breaks.
The air current throws you down.
I mean you no harm.
I lower my head and my breath spreads.
This much strength is no attack.
The pressure pins you to the stone.
The pressure pushes you back a few steps.
I've drawn my claw back.

lines.zh: 地裂开一道，不是我本意。
lines.en: The ground split; not my intent.
My weight is warning enough.
Hold still; I'll shift aside.
The red mist broke your fall.
I'd rather you stepped back.
The demon realm's balls have lit.
The red mist splits, and I emerge.
I rise from beneath the stone dais.
The sky darkens to violet.

lines.zh: 有人念出了魔界的咒语。
lines.en: Someone has spoken the demon realm's spell.

lines.zh: 我先露出眼睛，然后是头。
lines.en: First my eyes, then my head.
The stone forest is shaking.
I pass through the red mist and show my form.

lines.zh: 这地方的空气突然变重了。
lines.en: The air here suddenly grew heavy.

lines.zh: 魔界的三个愿望，由我实现。
lines.en: The demon realm's three wishes are mine to grant.
Thunder rolls above the demon realm.
The summoning circle glows below.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴从雾里抽出来。
lines.en: I draw my tail out of the mist.

lines.zh: 这个世界的天空太小了。
lines.en: This world's sky is too small for me.
I rise between the stones, slowly.
I'm here. You may speak.

lines.zh: 火在魔界的雾里烧，烧不动我。
lines.en: Fire burns in the demon mist and can't reach me.
I sink a little, then float again.

lines.zh: 这里没有海，水只是湿了我。
lines.en: There's no sea here; water only wets me.
The blast blows the red mist apart.

lines.zh: 一枚小东西撞在我鳞上。
lines.en: A small thing strikes my scales.
That spell disperses like mist.

lines.zh: 我靠愿望活着，不吃东西。
lines.en: I live on wishes; I do not eat.

lines.zh: 雷落在魔界的石上，也落在我身上。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the demon stone, and me with it.
The void opens its mouth beneath me.
